meta.out_of_scope_rule: An article counts as out-of-scope if its own journal represents less than 35% of nodes in its macro citation community (it clusters with other journals' literature).
meta.drift_rule: Drift is half the L1 distance between macro-community distributions for the same journal: baseline years vs recent years (0 = no change, up to ~1 = large shift).
meta.oos_by_year_rule: Per calendar year: same OOS rule as overall (own-journal share in macro community vs threshold); percentages use only articles published in that year.
